## Use this capability when the user means

- search source-linked Epstein court records
- verify an Epstein-related claim against public records

## Authority

public read-only guided research over source-linked court, government and civil-litigation records

## Boundaries

- a person's presence in a record or network does not establish culpability
- attorney claims, testimony, documents, allegations and verified facts must remain distinctly labeled
- citations and surrounding source context should remain accessible for verification
- the archive contains material related to child sexual abuse and trafficking and should preserve appropriate content warnings
- private journals, workspaces, accounts and administration surfaces remain outside public discovery
